title: 1C Things We Love — Хобби и свободное время

items.example: I tried mountain biking for the first time last year.
I stood at the top of a steep hill, about to set off towards the bottom.
We had lunch and then set off towards the bottom of the hill.
A friend persuaded me to help him with a landscaping project in his garden.
I had never been into gardening or doing physical work before.
Would you rather do a deep-sea dive or do a bungee jump?
He would choose a bungee jump over a deep-sea dive any day.
Would you rather fly a plane or parachute out of a plane?
I would go for being in a reality TV show every time.
Would you rather binge watch a TV show all day or read a book all day?
Kitesurfing was one of the activities the speakers discussed.
Given the choice, I would go for a lazy day at home.
Taking part in a dance competition is not really my thing.
We could do a helicopter tour of the city!
We could hop on a tour bus to get to know the city.
I enjoy having a free afternoon when I can sit with a good book.
